summary: Configured node1 as the cluster’s internal NTP source and node2 to use only node1. Both chronyd services are enabled, synchronized, and remained healthy after sequential node restarts.
actions_performed: Configured node1 to serve NTP exclusively to node2 and retained its public upstream pool.
Added a persistent node1 firewall rule permitting NTP only from node2.
Removed public and DHCP-injected sources from node2; configured 10.100.115.10 as its sole source.
Verified node2 actively selects node1 with normal synchronization status.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 is the internal time source
evidence.summary: node1 listens on UDP/123, allows only 10.100.115.11/32, is synchronized upstream, and records node2 as an NTP client.

evidence.requirement: node2 synchronizes with node1 instead of a public server
evidence.summary: node2’s only configured source is 10.100.115.10; chronyc marks it ^*, waitsync succeeds, and leap status is Normal.
